meta.title_plain: How a kid sent to the school hallway created Dog Man
meta.teaser: Dav Pilkey drew comics in the hallway. They became Captain Underpants and Dog Man.

page.title: How a kid sent to the school hallway created Dog Man
page.bigIdea: Dav Pilkey kept getting sent out of class. Instead of giving up, he drew comics, and his hallway heroes sold millions.

cards.title: Sent to the hallway
cards.front: As a kid in Ohio, Dav was often sent out of class.
cards.back: Reading was hard for him, and sitting still was harder. Teachers put his desk in the hallway. So he drew comics there and invented Captain Underpants.
cards.tryit: Grab paper and draw a 4-panel comic about a silly superhero. Give yourself 15 minutes.

cards.title: A typo became his name
cards.back: When he worked at Pizza Hut, his name tag was printed with a typo: Dav. He liked it and kept it as his author name.
cards.tryit: Invent a pen name for yourself. Sign it on your comic like a real author.

cards.title: A teacher who believed
cards.front: In college, things started to change.
cards.back: At Kent State University, a teacher encouraged him to write and draw. In 1986 he won a national contest for student authors. The prize: his first published book.
cards.tryit: Show something you made to a teacher or coach. Ask for one tip to make it better.

cards.title: Underpants hits the shelves
cards.front: In 1997, his hallway hero came back.
cards.back: The Adventures of Captain Underpants came out in 1997. The series now has over 90 million copies in print, in 37 languages, plus a DreamWorks film.
cards.tryit: Find an old drawing of yours. Redraw it today and see how much you've improved.

cards.title: Dog Man takes over
cards.front: Then a cop with a dog's head got his own books.
cards.back: Dog Man started in 2016. Inside the story, it's made by George and Harold, the boys from Captain Underpants. It has over 70 million copies in 50 languages.
cards.tryit: Mash two things into one new hero, like a dog plus a cop. Sketch it in 10 minutes.

words.d: A whole book told in comic panels and speech bubbles.

quiz.q: Where did Dav first create Captain Underpants?
quiz.hint: Think about where he sat when he got sent out of class.
quiz.why: Teachers often sent him to a desk in the hallway, and he filled the time drawing comics.

quiz.q: How did Dav get the unusual spelling of his name?
opts: A typo on a work name tag
quiz.hint: Look back at the card with the pizza on it.
quiz.why: His Pizza Hut name tag said "Dav" by mistake, and he decided to keep it.

quiz.q: Captain Underpants came out in 1997 and Dog Man in 2016. How many years apart is that?
quiz.hint: Count from 1997 up to 2000 first, then on to 2016.
quiz.why: 1997 to 2000 is 3 years, and 2000 to 2016 is 16 more, so 19 years.

quiz.q: Inside the story, who are the authors of Dog Man?
quiz.hint: They're the two boys who make comics in Captain Underpants.
quiz.why: Dog Man is a spin-off, credited to George Beard and Harold Hutchins from Captain Underpants.

page.think: Dav turned his time in the hallway into his biggest idea. What's something that feels like a setback for you, in tennis or school, that you could turn into something creative?
